name: HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES_
description:
The HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES table stores information specific to an Organization. This table gets populated or updated when a party of the type 'ORGANIZATION' is created or changed.
For example: this table stores the total number of employees in a company or whether a company is minority owned.
This table is also used to store historical data for the organization. Every time organization information is changed, the effective end date column for the original record is updated and a new record that contains the updated information is created.
